title: After picking a hero the player is a green smiley orb, then invisible, for about 3 s before the class sprite appears
steps: Open /game/games/mad-maze/index.html?mode=world&test=1&offline=1&seed=12345&heropick=1 at 1280x720
Click the first class card (Thicket Ranger)
Screenshot at +0.3 s, +1.5 s, +3 s, +6 s
expected: The chosen class sprite is drawn from the first frame (or the spawn pad shows a pixel placeholder of the class)
actual: Phone, loaded machine (load factor ~5): +0.1 s small green placeholder pip on the pad, +0.7 s pad EMPTY, +2.2 s placeholder again, class sprite only by ~5 s; terrain also flips flat -> textured. Desktop first run: empty pad at +0.15 s, orb at +0.85 s, sprite at +2.35 s.
suspect: game/games/mad-maze/mad-maze.js:270-300 (applyHero -> class strip load; the arena drops the fallback before the new strip has loaded) and shared/mm-art.js loadClass

title: World boss first appears as a pink cartoon devil face (code fallback) while its art lazy-loads
steps: Realm world test seed 12345, desktop
Walk (teleport) into the Godlands next to the Lich King site
Look at the boss in the first ~2 s after 'Lich King awakens!'
expected: Boss art is preloaded when the player nears a boss site, so the boss never shows a placeholder
actual: Void Maw is the full purple sprite on its first live frame after the preload; no pink fallback face seen.
suspect: game/games/mad-maze/mad-maze.js:257-262 (boss art loaded lazily on first draw); preload when the player is within N tiles of world.bossSites

title: Ghost outline lines run parallel to terrain borders (water and sand), offset from the actual edge
steps: Realm world seed 12345, Shore zone near tile (0,119) or the start beach
Look at the water/shallow and dirt/sand borders
expected: One clean transition per terrain border
actual: Shore water / sand / grass borders are single clean transitions, no parallel ghost line.

title: Highlands/Godlands: white snow patches drawn as frames with square holes; red lava areas are plus/cross blocks
steps: Realm world seed 12345, teleport to Highlands (tile 107,125) and Godlands (115,128)
actual: Highlands snow patches are still white frames with square holes and the lava area is still a hard-edged plus/cross.
suspect: shared/mm-overworld.js patch generator + realm-world.js tile pick (art is R32, the hole pattern is code)
